scene_description: Scuffed, paint-stained wooden workbench. An empty filament spool lies flat near the middle. An orange scraper lies flat at the front-left, and clear safety glasses lie at the front-right against the spool. Front is the bench edge nearest the viewer.

targets.name: filament spool
targets.description: Empty brown cardboard ELEGOO filament spool lying flat on one flange in the middle of the bench.
nearby_obstacles: Safety glasses touching its front-right rim
targets.clearance_notes: Rims and center hole are exposed, with open bench on most sides.
targets.other_notes: Spool is empty and may need to be replaced.

targets.name: 3D print scraper
targets.description: Orange plastic 3D print scraper lying flat on the bench to the front-left of the spool.
targets.clearance_notes: Open bench all around, but only 0.5 cm thick, leaving almost no edge to grip.

candidate_improvements.description: Slide the scraper to the front edge so its handle overhangs.

targets.name: safety glasses
targets.description: Clear plastic safety glasses lying on their side at the front-right of the spool, one end touching the spool's lower rim.
targets.orientation: lying on its side, arms folded
targets.clearance_notes: Mostly open, but one end is against the spool; clear plastic is hard to see.

candidate_improvements.description: Move the glasses approximately 5 cm right, away from the spool.

source: Staged permutation of S0043 and S0045, using the same objects in a different arrangement.
